title: Theory-Grounded Measurement of U.S. Social Stereotypes in English Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating stereotypic group-trait associations by applying the psychological Agency-Belief-Communion (ABC) model using template-based queries, measured via Increased Log Probability Score (ILPS), Contextualized Embedding Association Test (CEAT), and a novel Sensitivity Test (SeT).
